title: Senior Engineer- Automotive Technology Research
description:
**Job Description – Senior Engineer, Automotive Technology Research**

**Experience: 3-6 Years**

**Education: B.E./B.Tech from a reputed institute (MBA/MTech preferred)**

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a highly analytical and research-driven professional to support strategic automotive technology research initiatives. The role involves conducting in-depth technology analysis, competitive benchmarking, market intelligence, and trend monitoring across the automotive ecosystem.

The selected candidate will play a key role in generating actionable insights that support R&D strategy development, technology roadmaps, and leadership decision-making, with a strong focus on
**future mobility and CASE (Connected, Autonomous, Shared, Electric) technologies.**

**Key Responsibilities**

**Automotive Technology Research & Analysis**

* Conduct detailed research on emerging automotive technologies across:
* Powertrain
* Electrification
* Automotive Electronics
* Software Defined Vehicles
* Connected Mobility
* Autonomous Technologies
* Analyze technology strategies of global OEMs and Tier-1 suppliers.
* Develop technology landscapes, competitive intelligence reports, and benchmarking studies.
* Monitor developments within the CASE domain and identify disruptive trends.

**Competitive Intelligence & Benchmarking**

* Track competitor products, technology roadmaps, patents, and innovation activities.
* Build technology profiles and perform feature, performance, and cost comparisons.
* Evaluate technology adoption trends across global automotive markets.

**Data Collection & Analytics**

* Gather data from:
* Patents
* Technical Journals
* Research Publications
* Market Reports
* OEM Technical Releases
* Industry Databases
* Validate, clean, and analyze data using analytical tools.
* Generate meaningful insights from large datasets and market intelligence sources.

**Reporting & Insight Generation**

* Prepare:
* Research Reports
* Technology Assessment Reports
* Benchmarking Studies
* Executive Presentations
* Strategic Briefing Documents
* Convert complex technical and market information into concise business insights.
* Support R&D strategy and technology roadmap development.

**Project Execution**

* Support technology research projects from scoping through final delivery.
* Manage assigned research workstreams and ensure timely completion with high accuracy.
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders and technical teams to validate findings and recommendations.

**Required Skills**

**Automotive Technology Knowledge**

* Strong understanding of automotive technologies and industry trends.
* **Knowledge of CASE (Connected, Autonomous, Shared, Electric) technologies.**
* Understanding of OEM and Tier-1 supplier ecosystem.

**Research & Analysis Skills**

* Technology Analysis
* Competitive Benchmarking
* Trend Identification
* Technology Landscaping
* Market Research
* Strategic Analysis

**Data Analytics**

* Python
* SQL
* Database Management
* Data Mining
* Quantitative & Qualitative Analysis

**Communication Skills**

* Excellent report writing and presentation skills.
* Ability to communicate complex technical concepts to business and technical audiences.

**Preferred Skills**

* Exposure to Automotive Strategy Consulting or Technology Research Organizations.
* Experience supporting technology roadmaps or R&D planning activities.
* Power BI or Tableau
* Data Visualization
* Data Analytics Certification
* Patent Analytics
* Technology Forecasting

title: Industry 4.0 & Digitalization Engineer
description:
Experience in Industry 4.0 implementation, AI applications, digital manufacturing, IIoT, machine connectivity, manufacturing process improvement, production technology, OEE, predictive maintenance, dashboards, Power BI/Python/SQL, PLC/SCADA and cross-functional project execution.

**Responsibilities**

* Execute Industry 4.0 projects, machine connectivity, IIoT implementation, digital transformation roadmap.
* Study manufacturing processes, identify bottlenecks, improve OEE, productivity and quality.
* Implement AI/ML, dashboards, predictive maintenance, quality analytics.
* Coordinate PLC, SCADA, MES, ERP and industrial communication integration.
* Evaluate new technologies, conduct pilots and support digital innovation.

**Qualifications**

* B.E./B.Tech. (Mechanical/Mechatronics) with good academic record. Knowledge of Industry 4.0, AI, IIoT, PLC/SCADA, MES preferred with more than 70% marks in 10th, 12th and Engineering.
* Experience Range: 3 to 8 Years
